verdict.rationale: Stark Bank's API docs explicitly offer a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 specification as a YAML file, plus a Postman collection, which directly delivers a machine-readable API spec. The probe's 404s covered only JSON paths at conventional locations, so they do not contradict the documented YAML download. missing for 10: hands-on confirmation that the YAML file downloads and is complete, discoverability at a standard well-known/openapi.json path.
